text:
incident-bot: ALERT /incidents - HIGH 5xx spike in gateway eu-west-1 (rate: 18% -> 41%) – paging on-call: @alex, @mira
alex: Oncall here. Confirming alerts: gateway-error-rate > 20% for ~3m. Symptoms: 502/504 and upstream timeouts. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/gateway-eu-west1
mira: I see increased fanout from routing service to model-proxy pool. Latency SLOs violated. Checking recent deploys.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-09T21:15 UTC to routing-service started by @samir - build sha abcdef1 - status: SUCCESS
samir: That deploy touched the new connection pooling change. Rolling back to previous revision now. Initiating rollback to sha 1234567.
samir: rollback started -> running `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/routing-service routing=registry/redwood/routing:1234567` (ETA 90s)
len: I'm tailing gateway logs: `grep 'upstream_timeout' | tail -n 50` - lots of `upstream timeout after 20s` and `502 Bad Gateway` for trace ids short: trc: 7a2f... , 9b4c... . Also see `connection refused` to model-proxy-2.
kate: Support: seeing customer reports about timeouts on /v1/generate - small set of customers impacted (enterprise accounts in eu-west-1). Started incident banner on status page.
alex: Mitigation plan: 1) rollback routing-service (samir) 2) scale model-proxy pool + circuit-breaker tighten 3) enable fallback-to-quantized-model behind route 4) short-term rate-limit backoff for noisy clients
mira: I've bumped model-proxy ASG from 4 -> 8 in eu-west-1 and added 20% headroom. Also temporarily disabled aggressive connection pooling flag. Observing error rate dropping.
samir: rollback completed. Verified routing-service version 1234567. deploy-bot: rollback finished at 1765432380
len: Error rate dropped from 41% -> 9% over 3 minutes after ASG scale and rollback. CPU on model-proxy still high on a few nodes, redispatched some connections: `sudo systemctl restart model-proxy` on node ip 10.4.2.11
alex: OK that's good. Keeping paging open for 30m to monitor. Next: post-mortem items and action owners.
kate: Logged customer impact and who to notify. Creating support tickets for the 3 impacted customers and offering extended retry window.
mira: Immediate action items: - (A) Runbook update: add step to check recent routing-service deploys before paging (owner: mira) - (B) Alert tuning: split gateway 5xx alert by error class (502 vs 504 vs 503) and add rate threshold per region (owner: len) - (C) Autoscaling: add CPU-based scale trigger to model-proxy ASG (owner: samir) - (D) Add circuit-breaker dashboard and test (owner: alex)
alex: Also adding a short-term alert to detect sudden fanout increases from routing-service (threshold: x requests/s change). Will open PR.
samir: Will follow up with a small hotfix: revert connection-pool aggressive optimization permanently and add a config flag gated by traffic metric (PR link: https://github.com/redwood/routing/pull/432)
len: Runbook note: add CLI snippet for emergency ASG scale :
```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name model-proxy-eu-west1 --desired-capacity 8 --region eu-west-1
```
and temp circuit breaker toggle:
```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap circuit-config --patch '{"data":{"breaker_enabled":"true"}}'
```
kate: Support action: notify affected customers, attach incident summary, offer SLA credit if needed.
alex: I'm going to hand off monitoring to @mira for the next 60 minutes. If anything spikes, escalate to SRE rotation. Closing paging after stable 30m window.
mira: Acknowledged handoff. I'll update the runbook sections and add monitoring query examples.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated/monitoring. timeline: 1765432100 alert -> 1765432380 rollback -> 1765432500 ASG scale -> 1765432765 mitigated
alex: Post-incident follow ups: schedule postmortem doc, attach logs and traces, run failure replay to ensure fix. I'll create the postmortem doc and assign action items.
kate: Thanks everyone. I'll draft customer communications and sync with legal if needed.
samir: Quick note: we should add automated canary checks for routing changes to capture fanout anomalies before wide rollout.
len: Filing an alert tuning PR now. Will include split thresholds and a mute-window for noisy deploys.
mira: Closing thread - will update when PRs/changes merged. Great job team :thumbsup:
